title: Standing Still in the Storm of Spiritual Warfare
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor [Name] shares a heart-stopping account of a spiritual attack that left him on the brink of death, but God's intervention and the congregation's prayers proved to be the difference between life and loss. With raw honesty and spiritual insight, Pastor [Name] reveals the lessons he learned in the midst of this battle and how he fought back against the enemy's schemes. Listen as he shares a powerful lesson on standing strong in faith, even when the battle gets fierce.
